args.title: Corvid Packaging: Freight pricing this quarter — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Corvid Packaging newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Freight spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources: Corvid Packaging newsletter "Freight pricing this quarter" (newsletter@corvid.example); article at https://blog.corvid.example/2026/freight; companion piece at https://insights.corvid.example/freight/companion.
